items.label: U.S. House
items.text: U.S. Representative since January 2013 (elected in 2012); currently represents California's 25th District. (sources: Office of Rep. Raul Ruiz (house.gov) https://ruiz.house.gov/about/biography [search summary, primary]; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Raul_Ruiz_(politician) [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Medicine
items.text: Emergency physician at Eisenhower Medical Center, Rancho Mirage, from about 2007 until his election; emergency medicine residency at the University of Pittsburgh; fellowship at Brigham and Women's Hospital. (sources: U.S. House (committee repository bio) https://docs.house.gov/meetings/FA/FA16/20190226/108983/HHRG-116-FA16-Bio-R000599-20190226.pdf [search summary, primary])

items.label: Education
items.text: Graduated from UCLA; M.D., Harvard Medical School; M.P.P., Harvard Kennedy School; M.P.H., Harvard. (sources: Harvard Medical School https://hms.harvard.edu/news/congress-lens-physician [search summary, secondary]; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Raul_Ruiz_(politician) [search summary, secondary])
